Game Hens With Citrus Glaze
By: Kathy Mchenry
Published: Tuesday, January 5, 2010 - 12:40pm

Ingredients




2 game hens, split halfways
2 oranges
1 grapefruit
2 lemons
1/4 cup vegetable oil
1/4 cup honey

Preparation

1 Heat oven to 350 degrees F. Line a baking sheet with foil and spray with PAM. Lay the hens cut side down and pat dry with paper towels. 2 Juice all fruit into a bowl, add vegetable oil and honey. Whisk together to combine. Set half aside to heat and serve beside the hens. 3 Brush the glaze on the hens and bake for 40 minutes. Brush with glaze and cook an additional 40 minutes.

About


These little hens are delicious and extremely easy to prepare. I served with roasted sweet potatoes and extra citrus glaze on the side.
